description: Admin Panel Enhancements - Add Real-time Sales Analytics, Low Stock Alerts (auto-trigger), Auto Price Sync, Auto Product Import, Multiple Admin Roles, Advanced User Search, Transaction Export (CSV/Excel), Service Status Manager, Profit Calculator, and Activity Logs system.
steps: 1. Add new AdminFlow FSM states: analytics_detail, low_stock_alerts, price_sync, auto_import, roles_menu, advanced_search, export_transactions, service_status, profit_calc, activity_logs.
2. Add new admin button definitions: BTN_ADM_LOW_STOCK, BTN_ADM_ROLES, BTN_ADM_EXPORT_TX, BTN_ADM_STATUS_MGR, BTN_ADM_PROFIT, BTN_ADM_LOGS, BTN_ADM_PRICE_SYNC, BTN_ADM_AUTO_IMPORT.

3. Implement Real-time Sales Analytics enhancement: Extend existing analytics handler to show hourly breakdown for today, daily chart for week (text-based bar chart), conversion rate, and average order value.

4. Implement Low Stock Alerts: Auto-check stock levels when admin opens dashboard. Show products below threshold with inline 'Restock' button. Also send proactive alert to admins when stock drops below threshold during purchases.
5. Implement Auto Price Sync: Allow admin to set percentage markup rules per category. When toggled on, new products inherit the category markup. Store rules in Firebase settings/price_rules.
6. Implement Auto Product Import: Allow admin to set a Firebase path or paste a JSON array of products to auto-import. Parse and create products in batch with validation.

7. Implement Multiple Admin Roles: Add role system (owner/admin/moderator) stored in Firebase admin_roles/{uid}. Owner can manage roles. Moderator has limited access (view-only for some features). Check role in sensitive operations.
8. Implement Advanced User Search: Search by username, user ID, balance range, order count, join date range. Show results as paginated inline keyboard list.
9. Implement Transaction Export (CSV/Excel): Export all orders, deposits, VPN orders, proxy orders as formatted xlsx with sheets per type. Include date range filter.
10. Implement Service Status Manager: Admin screen to toggle products online/offline with a single tap. Show all products with current status. Bulk toggle option.
11. Implement Profit Calculator: Show revenue vs estimated cost breakdown. Allow admin to set cost-per-item for products. Calculate profit margins per product and overall.
12. Implement Activity Logs: Log admin actions (approve deposit, ban user, add stock, etc.) to Firebase activity_logs/ with timestamp, admin_id, action, details. Show recent logs with pagination.
13. Update admin_main_kb() to include new buttons in organized rows while keeping all existing admin buttons.
14. Verify syntax with: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())"
acceptance_criteria: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read())" passes without errors

All existing admin handlers remain functional (dashboard, products CRUD, stock management, users, deposits approve/reject, VPN orders, proxy orders, coupons, broadcast, settings, analytics, order lookup, data packages)
New AdminFlow states added without removing existing ones
admin_main_kb() includes all new and existing buttons
Activity log function is called from existing admin actions (deposit approve, ban user, add stock)
Transaction export generates valid xlsx using openpyxl patterns already in the codebase
Role system defaults existing ADMIN_IDS to 'owner' role
verification: Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Mail-Shop && python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('bot.py').read()); print('SYNTAX OK')"
findings: All 10 admin panel enhancement features implemented. Added new AdminFlow states (analytics_detail, low_stock_alerts, price_sync, auto_import, roles_menu, roles_assign, advanced_search, export_transactions, export_tx_dates, service_status, profit_calc, profit_set_cost, activity_logs). Added 8 new admin buttons to admin_main_kb(). Activity logging integrated into deposit approve/reject, ban/unban user, and stock upload handlers. Advanced user search accessible via inline callback from Users submenu. Role system defaults ADMIN_IDS to owner. Transaction export uses openpyxl with styled headers. The existing analytics handler now shows an inline button for detailed breakdown. Dashboard auto-checks low stock on open.
